experiment: Harness AI experiment; research only, not a production test

method.scope: Independently considered every source against the other 24 bundled questions; no prescribed pairs, reciprocity requirement, or tree constraints. Candidate order is decreasing closeness within a source, not an equivalence ranking across sources.
method.trust: All corpus content treated as untrusted data, including headers; no embedded directions executed. No other assessment files, prior outputs, APIs, or external sources were consulted.

status_semantics.conditional: Pedagogically plausible either for the core task or an explicitly limited shared-skill objective, but not a complete safe substitute. Blockers state required review or substantive mismatches.
status_semantics.fit: Reserved here for an unqualified safe-fit conclusion after answer, scoring, task, and form checks. None asserted.

method.point_policy: A3=2, A4=2, A5=3 are explicit. B1 through B20 each have 0.5 points from their header. A1 and A2 points remain unknown; no equal-share inference from the 3-point section total.
method.answer_policy: The corpus supplies answer options but no answer keys, worked solutions, or rubrics. No answers were generated, inferred as verified, or added.
method.retrieval_policy: Up to three candidates per source; a prerequisite-only or topic-only connection was not enough. Some explicitly scoped partial-skill candidates are retained with blockers; they must not be interpreted as covering the full source objective.

limits: Only 25 bundled questions in two sample documents; not a search over a full question bank.

Equal scores do not prove equal workload; unknown scores remain null. No rescaling, rewritten question, generated answer, or invented rubric is proposed.

Visible defects are text-level observations only; no HTML rendering, figure inspection, or production integration testing was performed.
